evaluation_methodology_changes.change: faithfulness relabeled to context_groundedness; hallucination_rate relabeled to unsupported_claim_rate.
evaluation_methodology_changes.rationale: Groundedness measures whether claims are supported by context, not absolute factual truth.

evaluation_methodology_changes.change: Replaced 'matches > 0' single-keyword rule with weighted required-fact coverage across structured atomic claims.
evaluation_methodology_changes.rationale: Prevents single irrelevant keyword matches from falsely crediting incorrect answers.

evaluation_methodology_changes.change: Purged all synthetic question-ID overrides (e.g. is_accurate = False for 3-hop vector queries).
evaluation_methodology_changes.rationale: Restores authentic pipeline measurement without hardcoded synthetic degradation.

evaluation_methodology_changes.change: Token F1 relabeled reference_text_token_f1 and chunk utilization relabeled lexical_chunk_overlap_utilization.
evaluation_methodology_changes.rationale: Clarifies that token overlap is a lexical proxy and does not prove semantic evidence utilization.

evaluation_methodology_changes.change: Decoupled answerability into Layer D. Refusals on answerable questions are failures; abstentions on unanswerable questions are successes.
evaluation_methodology_changes.rationale: Prevents refusals from achieving artificial 100% accuracy.

v1_metrics_summary.note: Computed using legacy keyword matches > 0 and synthetic 3-hop failure overrides.

v2_metrics_summary.note: Factual score is calculated only on answerable questions; abstentions are scored separately in Layer D.
